title_hi: मेरे दस नन्हे पैर - गिनती सीखें
title_en: My Ten Little Toes - Counting Rhyme
description: Learn to count to ten with Chintu the Elephant and Mithu the Parrot! A fun, educational song for toddlers and preschoolers. #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon #Counting
learning: Teaching children numbers 1 to 10 through interactive toe counting.

scenes.text: Arrey! Chintu ke pairo mein kya chhupa hai?!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, Chintu the orange baby elephant looking down at his feet with sparkly curious eyes, white background, high resolution, vibrant colors.
Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, Chintu wiggling his two front toes, Mithu the parrot flying above giggling, bright sunny playroom background.

scenes.text: Three and four, look at you!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, close up on Chintu's toes, Mithu pointing with his wing at the toes, cheerful expression, soft lighting.

scenes.text: Paanch aur chhe, let’s count more!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, Chintu jumping happily, counting on his feet, dynamic motion blur, vibrant playroom.

scenes.text: Seven, eight, hop on the floor!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, Chintu and Mithu jumping together on a colorful mat, big smiles, sparkles around them.

scenes.text: Nau aur das! We are done!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, Chintu showing all ten toes, Mithu holding a sign with the number 10, confetti in the air.

scenes.text: Hahaha! Counting toes is so much fun!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D CGI, Chintu and Mithu hugging, wide laughing expressions, happy atmosphere, bright yellow background.

scenes.text: Ruko! Kya tumne phir se gina?
